2.209.21
Map.PageBreak
Applies to RDL 2010/01 and RDL 2016/01
The Map.PageBreak element specifies page break behavior for a Map. This element is optional. This
element is of type PageBreak.
The following is the parent element of the Map.PageBreak element.
Parent elements
Map
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Map.PageBreak element.
 <xsd:element name="PageBreak" type="PageBreakType" minOccurs="0" />
